summary.text: Austin Harris is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 26, who took office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Brooke Boden, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A farmer, he earned an associate degree from Indian Hills Community College.

paragraphs.text: Austin Harris earned an A.A. from Indian Hills Community College in 2015, and his career experience includes working as a farmer.
For 2025-2026 he serves on the Appropriations, Commerce, Natural Resources and State Government committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Brett Mohler in the general election.
